profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Fastly
profile.summary: A hard working, professional practitioner with 36+ years of experience, specializing in the design and implementation of large-scale, high-performance software, including content delivery networks, antivirus engines, search engines, distributed file systems, databases, cloud and client/server architectures.  Very strong software design & development skills, imaginative, always a team player, loves to program in C/C++.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Enhance, maintain and optimize network software that implements protocols including TLS, HTTP, QUIC, etc.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Architect
positions.description: EdgeCast Cloud Services is a comprehensive solution for content delivery, security, web performance, traffic management, compute, and storage - offering a cost-effective alternative to AWS and Google Cloud.  I design, develop, and optimize large-scale, high-performance core CDN software used to deliver static and dynamic content, video streaming including video-on-demand (VOD) and live-event streaming.
